newsitem.title: USA: Thermo TerraTech unit wins contract.
newsitem.headline: Thermo TerraTech unit wins contract.

text.p: Thermo TerraTech Inc. said Monday its Bettigole Andrews Clark & Killam Associates Inc subsidiary has won a $6.5 million contract from the New York City Department of Transportation.
The four-year contract is for inspecting improvements to the Queensboro Bridge, which connects the boroughs of Manhattan and Queens.
This award is a follow-on contract to work the company began in 1995 as part of a $160 million bridge rehabilitation project," it said.
Thermo TerraTech is a public subsidiary of Thermo Electron Corp. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
